title: Delivery worker circuit breaker uses i64 millis, now_secs provides i64 secs
description: delivery.rs:226,149. The deliver_one function computes now_ms as chrono::Utc::now().timestamp_millis() (milliseconds) and passes it to CIRCUIT_BREAKER.record_failure(domain, now_ms). But the circuit breaker's is_open check at line 149 compares against now_secs() (seconds). If the circuit breaker compares these values directly, the units mismatch means the breaker window would be 1000x shorter than intended (e.g., a 60s window in seconds would be treated as 60ms when compared against millis). The actual behavior depends on fieldwork::circuit_breaker::CircuitBreaker's implementation.
